data_vintage: NASA FIRMS standard archive 2000–2025 (+2026 NRT, not used in tests)

gates.question: Held-out years

clauses.rule: better than baseline B1 (median of ratios) on identical rows
clauses.note: k better in 13 of 14 held-out years

gates.scope: every region with ≥ 100 VIIRS cell-days in the held-out year, 2012–2025
gates.summary: Median held-out error 9.7 % (limit 15 %). On identical rows k misses by 6.9 % and baseline B1 by 7.7 %.

gates.question: Held-out geography

clauses.note: k borrowed from the other countries of the same continent

gates.scope: countries, k learned from the rest of the same continent (local scope)
gates.summary: Borrowed k is 3.44× the in-region error (limit 1.5×, local scope).

gates.question: The 2012 seam

clauses.note: k learned from 2015–2025 only; whole countries resampled

gates.scope: regions with all years 2009–2014 and a raw step > 0.1 (log)
gates.summary: Median seam ratio 0.19 over 3081 regions (limit 0.25). With the cut-over years held out of the fit, the upper 95 % bound is 0.18.

gates.question: Placebo seams

clauses.rule: false-positive rate ≤ 10 % (Pettitt at fixed no-change years)
clauses.note: Pettitt statistic at a fixed split (Mann–Whitney U) inside one sensor era, at all 19 years with at least 2 years on each side (20 were planned; only 19 exist)

gates.scope: regions with ≥ 100 cell-days a year on average
gates.summary: Breaks found at 17.0 % of 3249 no-change tests (limit 10 %). Real fire trends inside one sensor era trip the test.

gates.question: Platform seams
gates.scope: harmonised annual series; the reference ruler stays VIIRS S-NPP
gates.summary: Break rate 7.6 % at 2018 and 10.5 % at 2023, no more than at years with no change (α = 0.05).

gates.question: Band coverage

clauses.rule: outer year removed before any score is made (nested)
clauses.note: calibration scores that saw the held-out year: 0

gates.scope: pooled over all regions, months with MODIS ≥ 10 cell-days
gates.summary: 94.76 % of 19,984 aggregate checks, pooled, MODIS ≥ 10 — not a per-month guarantee.

gates.question: Agreement
gates.scope: region-months 2012–2025 with ≥ 10 cell-days from each sensor, k learned without the held-out year
gates.summary: Bias -0.012 on the log scale over 19,725 region-months (limit ±0.1).

gates.question: Zero and empty

clauses.rule: never a made-up 0: a 0 only where the region had clear looks that month

gates.scope: all calendar regions through the API
gates.summary: No crash, every value has a status, and every 0 is backed by clear looks over that region that month; without them the month stays empty.

clauses.rule: water and city-centre cells ≈ 0, with status

gates.question: Persistent heat

clauses.rule: static, volcanic and offshore sources removed before counting
clauses.note: FIRMS type 0 only in calibration years 2012–2025

clauses.rule: checked against a list of known flares and kilns

gates.summary: Static sources are removed by FIRMS type before counting. Check against a known-site list: pending.

gates.question: Source classifier

clauses.rule: macro-F1 and abstain rate on held-out sites

gates.scope: only needed before a source label is shown; none is shown
gates.summary: Not tested yet. No source label is shown on the site.

gates.question: API provenance

clauses.rule: meta.data_source, status and version on every answer

gates.scope: every JSON endpoint of the API
gates.summary: Every API answer carries its data source, status and version.
